title: Successful login with valid credentials
description: Verify that a registered backend user can successfully authenticate and receive a JWT token using valid credentials.

title: Failed login with invalid password
description: Verify that authentication fails and returns a HTTP 401 Unauthorized status when the password does not match the username.

title: Successful payment execution
description: Verify that a user can successfully execute a payment transaction using a linked bank account when sufficient balance is present.

title: Payment rejected due to insufficient balance
description: Verify that the payment gateway rejects the transaction and throws an InsufficientBalanceException when processing an amount greater than the account balance.

title: Create a new buy order
description: Verify that a customer can successfully place a new mutual fund purchase order and the system updates the order status to PENDING.

title: Cancel a pending order before market cut-off
description: Verify that an active pending order can be successfully cancelled by the user prior to the daily transaction cut-off window.

title: Send SMS notification on successful transaction
description: Verify that an asynchronous SMS message notification is dispatched to the user's registered phone number immediately after a transaction completes.

title: WOE is the main application or service from where the buy sell and exchange of mutual funds happens
description: Verify that the WOE application correctly handles buy, sell, and exchange operations for mutual funds, ensuring accurate processing and updates to user portfolios.
